source_text: By the 1990s, international organizations amplified these initiatives; WHO issued a 1995 policy statement classifying FGM as a violation of human rights with no health benefits, while UNICEF launched community-based programs in high-prevalence areas, reporting shifts in attitudes in pilot villages in Burkina Faso and Mali. [12]
